Action.description:
A semantic action emitted by interactive nodes (button, menu).

Payloads are data only (§23); the host resolves `id` through its own policy before executing anything.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON payload carried to the host.

ArtifactPreview.description: `artifact.preview` — what an artifact card shows inline: a short summary and/or an inline surface descriptor (ADR 0007).

surface.description: Inline surface descriptor rendered inside the preview.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version carried by the payload.

ArtifactWorkspace.description: `artifact.workspace` — the contract a host honors when the user opens an artifact: a presentation mode, an optional detail surface descriptor, and a lazy render hint (ADR 0007).

lazy.description: Lazy render hint: the renderer may defer mounting the workspace until it becomes visible.

surface.description: Detail surface descriptor rendered inside the workspace.

ColumnAlign.description: Semantic cell alignment within a `table` column.

Distribution.description: Main-axis distribution of children within a container.

IconSize.description: Icon size (semantic, resolved by renderer theme).

InputType.description: Input field type (semantic; renderers map to platform keyboards).

tone.description: Semantic tone for the value (e.g. status-ish rows).

action.description: Action emitted when the item is chosen.

value.description: Option value submitted via action payloads.

SurfaceDescriptor.description: An inline surface descriptor: a self-contained semantic node tree carried inside another entity (e.g. `artifact.preview`/`artifact.workspace`) rather than registered as a session surface (ADR 0007).

root.description: Root node — must be a `surface` node.

SurfaceNode.description:
AIUX Surface Schema v1 node. Serialized as `{"type": "<kind>", ...}`.

The primitive set is closed: `surface`, `card`, `stack`, `row`, `grid`, `heading`, `text`, `markdown`, `code`, `icon`, `image`, `badge`, `divider`, `spacer`, `keyValue`, `list`, `listItem`, `table`, `button`, `menu`, `progress`, `status`, `input`, `textarea`, `select`, `checkbox`, `radio`, `field`, `form`, `actions`, `custom`.

oneOf.description: Root surface container. Only valid as the tree root.

children.description: Child nodes laid out into the grid.

oneOf.description: Ordered or unordered list of nodes.

rows.description: Rows; each row must match the effective column count. Cells may be bare strings (text cells) or typed cell objects.

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

name.description: Field name submitted in action payloads.

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

name.description: Field name submitted in action payloads.

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

name.description: Field name submitted in action payloads.

placeholder.description: Placeholder when no value is selected.

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

name.description: Field name submitted in action payloads.

required.description: Whether input is required (must be checked before submission).

oneOf.description: Single-choice radio group (same option model as `select`).

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

name.description: Field name submitted in action payloads.

options.description: Options (must be non-empty; `value` must be one of them).

oneOf.description: Labelled field group: one label/hint/error for its control children.

children.description: Child nodes (typically one or more field controls).

errorText.description: Author-provided validation message rendered by the renderer.

helperText.description: Helper text rendered under the controls.

required.description: Whether the field is required (display semantics).

oneOf.description:
Interactive form: collects named field values on submit.

Named field descendants contribute their current value to the nearest enclosing `form`. Activating the submit affordance emits `submit` with the collected `fields` object merged into its payload. Forms may not nest.

submit.description: Action emitted on submit; `fields` is merged into its payload.

submitLabel.description: Submit button label (renderer-chosen default when omitted).

oneOf.description: Structured list row; only valid as a direct child of `list`.

action.description: Action emitted when the row is activated.

children.description: Nested content rendered under the row.

oneOf.description:
Host-registered custom node (ADR 0007).

`kind` is a host-namespaced identifier (e.g. `acme.sparkline`); `props` is free-form data, never code (§23). Hosts register `kind → renderer`; an unregistered `kind` degrades to the renderer's unknown-node placeholder (§21).

kind.description: Host-namespaced node kind (`aiux.*` reserved for built-ins).

props.description: Free-form props passed to the registered renderer.

oneOf.description: Action row/container; children must be `button` or `menu` nodes.

TableCell.description: A `table` cell: a bare string renders as text; an object is a typed cell.

align.description: Semantic cell alignment for the column.

key.description: Stable column key (used for alignment/cell mapping).

Tone.description: Semantic tone for badges, statuses, and emphasis.

oneOf.description: Numeric cell (rendered with column alignment semantics).

WorkspaceMode.description: How an opened artifact workspace presents (ADR 0007).

description: The canonical event envelope. `P` defaults to a raw JSON payload for dispatch-time parsing; typed instantiations (`AiuxEvent<SessionCreated>`) are used for schema generation and typed producers.

eventId.description: Unique event identifier — replays of a known id are ignored.

type.description: Event type, e.g. `session.created`. Unknown values deserialize fine and fail later with `ProtocolError::Unsupported`.
